metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2020 · Dil Bechara
metas.description: The emotional journey of two hopelessly-in-love youngsters; a young girl, Kizie, who is suffering from cancer; and Manny, a boy Kizie meets at a support group.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2023 · Hi Nanna
metas.description: A single father begins to narrate the story of the missing mother to his child and nothing remains the same.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2023 · Past Lives
metas.description: Nora and Hae Sung, two deeply connected childhood friends, are wrested apart after Nora's family emigrates from South Korea. Twenty years later, they are reunited for one fateful week as they confront notions of love and destiny.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2024 · Premalu
metas.description: Sachin's quest for love takes unexpected turns, creating a laughter-filled love triangle.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2023 · Poor Things
metas.description: An account of the fantastical evolution of Bella Baxter, a young woman brought back to life by the brilliant and unorthodox scientist Dr. Godwin Baxter.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2021 · The Worst Person in the World
metas.description: The chronicles of four years in the life of Julie, a young woman who navigates the troubled waters of her love life and struggles to find her career path, leading her to take a realistic look at who she really is.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2023 · All of Us Strangers
metas.description: A screenwriter drawn back to his childhood home enters into a fledgling relationship with his downstairs neighbor while discovering a mysterious new way to heal from losing his parents 30 years ago.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2023 · Kaiva
metas.description: Inspired from the true incidents occurred in Bengaluru - 1983, Kaiva brings the visual grandeur of Old Bengaluru showing the lights of world famous Bengaluru Karaga and the dark underworld of the city as well.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2021 · Shiddat
metas.description: A passionate love story involving two couples which highlights the contrast between a regular, mature yet egoistic husband and a unique, happy go lucky, enamored, overzealous boy chasing after the love of his life.
